items.title: Stocks in news: Infosys, Mazagon Dock, Fortis Healthcare, JSW Energy and Kalpataru Projects
items.description: On September 16, Indian markets experienced a careful resurgence, with the Nifty and Sensex both moving upwards. This rebound was fueled by increased investments in banking and prominent stocks following a steep drop the previous day. Key players like Infosys and Mazagon Dock are under scrutiny due to recent corporate events.

items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: Indian benchmark indices closed marginally higher after a volatile trading session. The US Federal Reserve increased its main interest rate for the first time in three years. This decision led to a slip in US stock markets on Wednesday. Foreign portfolio investors were net sellers, while domestic institutional investors bought shares. The Indian Rupee weakened for the seventh consecutive session against the US dollar.

items.title: Retail investors shift from secondary market to IPOs in July-August, selling Rs 5,674 crore
items.description: Indian retail investors sold equities in July and August. They then invested heavily in primary market IPOs during this period. This shift occurred after significant buying in the previous quarter. Analysts suggest this is a tactical allocation change for profit booking. Strong IPO activity and listing gains are attracting this capital.

items.title: These mid-caps have ‘strong buy’ & ‘buy’ recos and an upside potential of over 25%, according to analysts
items.description: As an investor, what you need to do at this point of time is this: A bit of extra work in terms of stock-picking so that you avoid anxiety during future corrective phases in the market. And there should not be any doubt that, given the current geopolitical conditions, there will be many more corrective phases.

items.title: UPI MDR could create Rs 27,000 crore revenue pool by FY28: Bernstein
items.description: A 40-basis-point MDR on UPI transactions could create a large revenue pool. Issuing banks and UPI apps will receive substantial portions of this estimated revenue. Merchant-side payment apps and acquiring banks will also capture significant revenue shares. This levy aims to sustain UPI infrastructure and support its continued expansion. The charges remain well below card fees and exempt many smaller transactions.

items.title: RBI clarifies principal business rules for NBFCs, CIC definition after Tata Sons CoR rejection
items.description: The Reserve Bank of India has clarified definitions for financial activity and core investment companies. This clarification follows the rejection of Tata Sons' application to surrender its registration. Companies must meet specific asset and income thresholds to be regulated by the central bank. Tata Sons, an unlisted holding company, now faces enhanced regulatory scrutiny. The central bank's decision effectively pushes Tata Sons towards a mandatory public listing.

items.title: UPI MDR could cost 47.2 bps with GST for merchants
items.description: The new framework introduces a 0.4% MDR on person-to-merchant UPI transactions above Rs 2,000, capped at ?300 on transactions of Rs 75,000 and above, while consumers will not be charged. It takes effect from October 15. GST is paid by the service provider who typically recover the amount from whoever receives service.

items.title: Highway Infrastructure shares jump 5% after securing Rs 220 crore order from UPEIDA
items.description: Highway Infrastructure shares rose nearly 5% to Rs 45.90 after the company secured a Rs 220.66 crore contract from UPEIDA for toll collection and plaza operations on the Gorakhpur Link Expressway. The two-year order includes annual escalation. The company also recently secured an Rs 80.16 crore Tamil Nadu toll plaza project.

items.title: Glass Wall Systems shares rally 32% in 2 days after IPO. What should investors do?
items.description: Glass Wall Systems shares rallied 12% on Thursday, extending gains after a 7% premium listing and an 18% rise on debut. Analysts highlighted project execution, earnings growth, margins and cash-flow generation as key factors to watch.

items.title: BEML among 4 stocks closing above VWAP
items.description: On September 16, closing prices of four stocks in the Nifty500 pack were more than 2.5% above their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Prices), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data.When the closing price is above VWAP, it means the stock closed at a price higher than its volume-weighted average traded price during the day. The VWAP gives greater weight to prices at which higher trading volumes occurred.

items.title: LCC Projects makes strong D-Street debut, listing at 31% premium over IPO price
items.description: LCC Projects made a strong stock-market debut after its Rs 427.14 crore IPO. The shares listed at Rs 191.90 on the NSE, a 31.44% premium, and at Rs 189 on the BSE, a 29.45% premium over the issue price of Rs 146.

items.title: Asset Reconstruction Company shares list flat at Rs 139 on BSE, NSE
items.description: On Thursday, shares of Asset Reconstruction Company India Ltd. debuted with little movement following a notable initial public offering valued at Rs 732.97 crore, consisting entirely of an offer for sale. Priced at Rs 139 per share, the offer attracted significant demand, seeing an impressive twenty-fold subscription. Notably, the proceeds will benefit the selling shareholders, rather than the company itself.

items.title: Gold prices fall Rs 2,000/10 gram, silver dips Rs 4,600/kg as US Fed hikes rate after 3 years. Time to sell?
items.description: Gold and silver prices fell sharply on the MCX on Thursday after the US Federal Reserve raised interest rates and signalled further tightening.  Easing oil supply concerns also weighed on bullion sentiment, as higher rates make non-yielding assets less attractive.

items.title: Manipal Payment & Identity Solutions lists at 2% discount to IPO price
items.description: Manipal Payment & Identity Solutions made a weak stock market debut after its Rs 805-crore IPO was subscribed 1.26 times overall. The shares opened at a discount to the issue price on both the BSE and NSE. The IPO comprised a fresh issue and an offer for sale, with proceeds earmarked primarily for capital expenditure across the company’s manufacturing facilities.

items.title: HDFC Bank is winning the mutual fund vote over ICICI Bank. Can the shift last?
items.description: HDFC Bank’s stock has fallen 27% in 2026, while ICICI Bank has gained 1.6%. Yet mutual funds have increasingly favoured HDFC Bank, adding to the laggard while trimming ICICI Bank. By August-end, ICICI Bank remained the larger mutual-fund holding, but the recent flow pattern signals a shift in preference as investors assess HDFC Bank’s valuation and recovery potential.

items.title: GR Infraprojects shares drop 2% after terminating contract with NTPC. Here’s why
items.description: Shares of GR Infraprojects fell 2% after the company issued a notice to terminate its contracts with NTPC for a Battery Energy Storage System project at Mouda Super Thermal Power Station. The termination follows continuing force majeure and war-risk circumstances, along with contractual issues. GR Infraprojects has invoked the dispute resolution mechanism and is assessing the financial impact of the move.

items.title: Reliance Industries shares in focus as govt slashes windfall tax on fuel exports; stock down 21% in 2026 so far
items.description: Reliance Industries will remain in focus after the government cut windfall taxes on petrol, diesel and ATF exports. The company, a major exporter of ATF and diesel, is also raising Rs 12,500 crore through a five-year bond issue amid continued volatility in oil prices.

items.title: Infosys, TCS, other IT stocks in focus after first Fed rate hike in 3 years. Will inflationary pressures offset anti-AI euphoria?
items.description: Indian IT stocks such as Infosys and TCS are likely to remain in focus after the US Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 25 basis points, citing elevated inflation. Analysts expect higher-for-longer rates to pressure risk assets, while AI-related developments could influence sentiment towards Indian IT stocks.

items.title: Patanjali Foods among 4 stocks showing RSI uptrend
items.description: On September 16, four stocks from the Nifty500 pack that gained over 3% featured in the “RSI Trending Up” scan, based on data from StockEdge. An uptrend signal occurs when the RSI crosses above 50 from below. “RSI Trending Up” indicates that the Relative Strength Index (RSI) is rising, signalling strengthening price momentum. RSI is a technical indicator commonly used by traders to assess price momentum and trend strength.

items.title: Dividend alert! Last day to buy Cochin Shipyard, LT Foods among nearly 90 stocks for dividends. Do you own any?
items.description: On September 18, ninety companies will observe their dividend record date, and investors must acquire shares prior to this date to be eligible. Notably, Victoria Mills is set to provide the largest dividend at fifty rupees per share. Additionally, numerous companies have shared their dividend announcements, offering a last chance for investors to capitalize on these payouts.

items.title: Stock split alert! Last day to buy these 2 multibagger stocks before record date
items.description: On Friday, Kairosoft AI Solutions and Oriana Power will officially go ex-record date for their announced stock splits. To partake in these corporate movements, investors need to purchase shares by Thursday. Kairosoft AI Solutions is implementing a substantial 1:10 split due to significant gains, while Oriana Power plans a 1:5 split after experiencing a recent downturn, aiming to boost investor share count.

items.title: PVR Inox buyback: Last chance to participate in multiplex operator's Rs 300 crore buyback. Should you tender shares?
items.description: The record date for the buyback was scheduled for September 4. This means only those shareholders who owned shares of the company on that day are eligible to tender shares in the offer, and investors taking fresh positions today will not qualify.

items.title: Oracle Financial Services Software among 5 F&O stocks with sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of September 16, five stocks in the NSE F&O segment recorded a rise of more than 5% in futures open interest compared with the previous trading session. A notable increase in futures open interest indicates a substantial rise in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a security. This can reflect market participants initiating new positions or increasing the size of existing positions.
